topic: Ecological relationships: competition, predation, and symbiosis
key_concepts: Living things interact through competition, predation, and symbiosis.
Competition occurs when organisms vie for limited resources such as food, space, sunlight,
Plants in a rainforest compete for sunlight and nutrients.
Predation is an interaction in which a predator kills and consumes prey for food.
Predators help maintain ecosystem balance and prevent prey overpopulation and overgrazing.
Prey species have adaptations such as speed and evasive movement to survive predators.
